decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly committed to the product on its website, and escalation of commitment leads management to persist despite uncertain results.
The wooden nativity stable is central to the firm's traditional product line and has been publicly launched, so management is likely to justify the prior investment by keeping it.
The modern incense smoker figurine represents a visible commitment to innovation within the firm's established crafts, and temporary causes can explain any weak early sales, leading to persistence.
